about: Request a certificate proving you or your company is a UAE tax resident, or a commercial activity certificate.
note: Requirements read from the official FTA service page on the checked date. FTA fills the form in after sign-in and does not publish its field labels, so this guide has no fields to read yet. Tax residency certificate. Translations not reviewed by native speakers.

eligibility: Applicant must be a UAE tax resident under UAE law or under a double taxation agreement
Companies must have been established for at least 12 months
Branches of foreign companies and offshore companies are not eligible
A certificate cannot cover a future period or more than 12 months
documents: Individuals: Emirates ID and passport with an official entry and exit report, plus proof depending on days spent in the UAE
Companies: valid licence and lease, certificate of incorporation, memorandum of association, signatory's Emirates ID and passport with proof of authority
Treaty certificates: passport is always required
Commercial activity certificate: active VAT TRN and a request letter
fees: AED 50 for submission on every application
AED 1,000 for an individual without a corporate tax TRN
AED 1,750 for a company without a corporate tax TRN
AED 500 for a corporate tax registrant
timing: FTA decides within 10 business days of a complete application
Hard copy in 5 business days after payment
channels: trc.tax.gov.ae, sign in with UAE PASS
Hard copies are couriered to a UAE address only
